title: Hearty French Spaghetti Pasta
description: A vegetarian friendly French inspired spaghetti dish featuring double fried vegetables and a rich Normandy sauce.
instructions: Bring a large pot of salted water to a boil and cook the spaghetti according to the package instructions.
In a large skillet heat the vegetable oil over medium high heat.
Add the chopped onion to the skillet and cook until it is translucent.
Add the sliced mushrooms and zucchini to the skillet and cook until they are tender.
Add the minced garlic to the skillet and cook for 1 minute.
Add the tomato paste to the skillet and cook for 1 minute.
Add the white wine and vegetable broth to the skillet and bring to a boil.
Reduce the heat to low and simmer the sauce for 10 minutes.
Stir in the shredded gruyere cheese until it is melted and well combined.
Serve the spaghetti hot topped with the Normandy sauce and double fried vegetables.
